scope: Processor-relevant requirements in the registered RDF 1.2, SPARQL 1.2, and SHACL 1.2 document families

reviewState.enumeration: Grouped processor obligations; not yet a sentence-by-sentence RFC 2119 extraction

policies.stableId: Requirement IDs are permanent; changed meaning requires a new ID.

dispositions.pass: The obligation has implementation evidence, applicable tests, and a reviewed source mapping.
dispositions.unsupported: Implementation, evidence, or normative review remains incomplete; this does not necessarily mean all related behavior is absent.
dispositions.not-applicable: The document or obligation is informative or outside the declared processor surface, with a recorded rationale.
dispositions.blocked-upstream: A pinned upstream artifact is invalid or supplies no executable oracle.
dispositions.draft-unclear: The mutable draft does not yet support a stable requirement interpretation.

policies.promotionGate: An official-suite pass is evidence only. It never changes a normative disposition to pass without implementation inspection and source-section review.
policies.draftPin: Each document records the SHA-256 of response bytes observed on 2026-07-26. Mutable TR and editor URLs remain mutable; the hash is an observation, not an immutable URL.

requirements.section: SPARQL architecture, terminology, and data model
requirements.obligation: Use a consistent RDF 1.2 term, dataset, solution, and operation model across query, update, protocol, results, and entailment surfaces.
requirements.gap: The editor draft is mutable and has not been enumerated against every dependent specification.

requirements.gap: The 269-case suite is green, but the grammar production-to-test/source review is not complete.

requirements.gap: No complete algebra-operator normative matrix and supplemental edge corpus is recorded.

requirements.obligation: Apply specified effective-boolean-value, error propagation, datatype, function, aggregate, ordering, grouping, projection, and slicing semantics.

requirements.obligation: Close every applicable syntax, algebra, evaluation, extension-function, and result requirement across exposed interfaces.

requirements.obligation: Accept every conforming SPARQL 1.2 Update request and reject invalid update syntax.
requirements.gap: Production-level coverage and negative-edge mapping are incomplete.

requirements.section: Graph Store; Update Operations; Formal Model
requirements.obligation: Apply insert, delete, modify, load, clear, create, drop, copy, move, and add operations atomically with specified SILENT and error behavior.
requirements.gap: Complete operation/error/transaction clause mapping is not recorded.

requirements.obligation: Close all update requirements across in-memory, persistent, CLI, and HTTP entry points.
requirements.gap: Cross-interface and operational evidence is incomplete.

requirements.obligation: Expose a discoverable service description at the service endpoint using the required response and graph conventions.
requirements.review: Queryless GET discovery, RDF content negotiation, endpoint triples, and the bounded service graph are covered by the native service-description and HTTP tests. This closes only discovery; it does not close the service-description vocabulary or SPARQL 1.2 family conformance.

requirements.obligation: Describe supported languages, result formats, entailment regimes, features, endpoints, and named graphs without advertising unsupported capability.
requirements.gap: Capability publication and negative-advertisement tests are absent.

requirements.obligation: Parse SERVICE and SERVICE SILENT, bind endpoint terms as specified, and reject or report invalid service names correctly.
requirements.review: The reviewed Basic Federated Query surface covers fixed and variable endpoints, invalid endpoint terms, SERVICE SILENT, and non-SILENT error propagation. Variable endpoints are supported as an informative extension and are not used to overstate the normative claim.

requirements.obligation: Evaluate remote graph patterns, joins, variable endpoints, SILENT failures, content negotiation, and result parsing with bounded operational policy.
requirements.review: Hermetic HTTP tests cover POST query transport, JSON and XML result negotiation, RDF 1.2 terms, joins, blank-node scope, timeout policy, wire requests, and atomic suppression of lazy failures under SERVICE SILENT. This is Basic Federated Query evidence, not an unrestricted network-policy claim.

requirements.section: JSON Result Object; Bindings; Serialization and Conformance
requirements.obligation: Parse and serialize SELECT/ASK results in the SPARQL 1.2 JSON format, preserving RDF 1.2 term kinds and rejecting malformed structures.
requirements.review: Native parser and serializer tests cover result-object structure, SELECT and ASK, malformed member combinations, version and RDF 1.2 feature gates, document-scoped blank nodes, directional literals, triple terms, and recursive nested triples.

requirements.obligation: Serialize SELECT results as specified CSV, including headers, escaping, triple-term lexical forms, and the format's documented loss of RDF term distinctions.
requirements.review: The pinned CSV specification defines a SELECT-results surface, not ASK. Native CSV serialization tests cover headers, row escaping, lossy RDF-term boundaries, and SPARQL 1.2 triple terms; any library ASK behavior is outside this conformance disposition.

requirements.obligation: Parse and serialize SELECT TSV results using the specified RDF term lexical forms, escaping, headers, and error behavior.
requirements.review: The pinned TSV specification defines a SELECT-results surface, not ASK. Native tests cover headers, term escaping, negative parsing, round trips, directional literals, triple terms, and recursive nested triples; any library ASK behavior is outside this conformance disposition.

requirements.obligation: Parse and serialize SELECT/ASK XML results, preserving RDF 1.2 term kinds, namespaces, escaping, and specified structural errors.
requirements.gap: The complete 1.2 schema, negative, and round-trip matrix is not closed.

requirements.obligation: For each advertised regime, construct the active graph and answer patterns according to the regime's entailment and scoping rules.
requirements.gap: Reasoners exist, but SPARQL dataset integration and regime-specific query-answer evidence are incomplete.

requirements.obligation: Advertise only supported entailment regimes and expose consistent behavior through service description and query interfaces.
requirements.review: The service advertises the standard Simple regime and custom identifiers for bounded RDF, RDFS, and OWL 2 RL profiles, with unavailable profiles rejected at startup and query behavior covered by native tests. This truthful advertisement does not claim the bounded profiles implement the full standard entailment regimes or close SPARQL 1.2 family conformance.

requirements.obligation: Implement query request methods, parameter encoding, dataset parameters, content negotiation, success responses, and specified protocol errors.
requirements.review: Native HTTP and raw HTTP/1.1 tests cover GET and direct/form POST encoding, rejection of form parameters in the request URI, protocol dataset replacement of query FROM clauses, content negotiation, malformed and option errors as 400, pre-execution refusal and execution failure as 500, and authoritative in-band VERSION precedence. This closes the separate query-protocol surface only, not SPARQL 1.2 family conformance.

requirements.obligation: Implement update request methods, parameter encoding, media types, success responses, and specified protocol errors.
requirements.review: Native HTTP and raw HTTP/1.1 tests cover direct and form POST encoding, rejection of form parameters in the request URI, repeated using-graph and using-named-graph dataset semantics, rejection of protocol datasets combined with USING or WITH, success responses, malformed requests, and execution failures as 500. This closes the separate update-protocol surface only, not SPARQL 1.2 family conformance.

requirements.section: Graph Store HTTP Protocol; GET and HEAD
requirements.obligation: Select default or named graphs, negotiate an RDF representation, return the specified status and validators, and preserve graph semantics.
requirements.review: In-process and raw HTTP/1.1 tests cover direct and indirect default/named-graph selection, rejection of relative indirect selectors, missing-graph status, GET/HEAD representation agreement, RDF content negotiation including RDF 1.2 term/version boundaries, ETag and Content-Length, and conditional retrieval. Selector-less dataset GET and HEAD are documented Oxigraph extensions and are excluded from this GSP disposition; this pass does not close SPARQL 1.2 family conformance.

requirements.obligation: Apply graph replacement, merge, creation, and deletion with specified request preconditions, status codes, media types, and atomicity.
requirements.review: In-process and raw HTTP/1.1 tests cover PUT create/replace, POST merge only into an existing selected graph, selector-less POST graph allocation with 201 and Location, empty selector-less POST, DELETE, conditional writes, media-type and selector errors, and rollback after malformed, dataset, or multipart-dataset payloads. Selector-less dataset PUT and DELETE are documented Oxigraph extensions and are excluded from this GSP disposition; this pass does not close SPARQL 1.2 family conformance.
